blurb: Guests can join guided kayak tours or rent kayaks for self-guided paddling trips. Rentals typically last 2 hours, allowing trips to Canalside, Naval Park, or upstream through Tift Nature Preserve to Red Jacket Park. The business offers adaptive kayaking equipment and welcomes well-behaved dogs with flotation devices.
extraNote: Reservations limited to two per booking; confirmation call required before finalizing · Notify ASAP if unable to attend to allow seat to be filled
